messages:
Anna (Design): hey team — posted a quick prototype of the model catalog filters + compare state here: https://figma.com/file/xyz (see ‘filter bar / pinned version’ frame). main asks: how should filter state persist across nav and what aria hints do we need for the chips?
Mike (PM): thanks — user need: if I select filters and open compare, I expect the same filters to apply when I return. also we want permalinkable states for support tickets.
Jean (A11y): +1 on permalinks. for aria: chips should be buttons with aria-pressed, not just decorative. keyboard focus order matters when chips collapse into a menu.
Sam F (Frontend): quick note — we currently serialize filters to URL querystring for search pages. that supports permalinks but can get long (many tags). do we want a compact token for catalog?
Luis (FE): technically we can do both: URL for share + localStorage for short-term persistence (back/forward). downside: dual sources can get out of sync unless we pick a priority rule.
Anna (Design): proposal: priority = URL if present, else last local state. show a tiny toast: "Filters restored from last session — view" with an undo. also add a clear-all affordance on the left of chips.
Mike (PM): undo toast sounds good. does the toast need an explicit label for screen readers?
Jean (A11y): yes — toast should be role="status" and include a button labeled "Undo filter restore". chips: add aria-label that includes filter type+value (e.g., \"Filter: size = medium\").
Sam F (Frontend): implementation note: aria-pressed + role=button for each chip. sample snippet: `button.role('filter-chip').attr('aria-pressed', isActive)` — simple.
Anna (Design): copy tweak: instead of "Clear all", consider "Clear filters" to be explicit. also for pinned version UI (pin icon next to model row) we should show tooltip: "Pin this model version for comparisons".
Luis (FE): pinning has edge cases — pinned version ID must persist with the user (account-level) OR be session-only. which do we prefer?
Mike (PM): prefer account-level for power users, but default to session-only for guests. treat pinning as a separate product decision — add to roadmap.
Jean (A11y): small keyboard nits: when opening compare modal, focus should land on first sortable column header, not the modal X. ensures keyboard users can navigate table quickly.
Anna (Design): noted. also accessibility color nits on badges: performance badge colors fail AA at small sizes. we should adopt patterns from our badges guidelines (larger contrast + icon).
Sam F (Frontend): can we switch to outline + icon for small badges? easier than recoloring.
Anna (Design): yep mock updated — outline + small lightning icon. feedback?
Luis (FE): looks doable. two implementation asks: 1) provide exact color tokens, 2) small-svg for the icon (optimized).
Mike (PM): ok action items: Anna to update figma w/ toast copy + badge style; Jean to write accessibility checklist for chips/toast/compare modal; Luis & Sam to prototype URL vs localStorage sync and pinning behavior. I’ll schedule a quick 20m follow-up tomorrow.
design-bot: Reminder: design review synced to calendar at 11:00am tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:
Anna (Design): thanks all — tiny follow-up: change label from "Undo" to "Restore filters" in the toast for clarity. low-risk copy change. :sparkles:
Jean (A11y): approving the aria approach, pending the checklist.
Sam F (Frontend): will try an experiment: encode filters as compact base64 JSON in URL to keep length down. will share POC link.
Luis (FE): will pair with Sam on sync logic. marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
